watches.name: SEIRAN Green Dial × Silver Hands Roman Numerals with Stainless Steel
watches.description: Scheduled to ship around December The "SEIRAN" is JIOS's first model, featuring a refined classic design that adds a stylish touch to your wrist. It is simple yet elegant, with a combination of Roman numerals and bar indices for easy readability, along with a date display for added functionality. The dial, adorned with a guilloché pattern, boasts a sleek, sophisticated form that makes it suitable for both business and casual occasions. The use of three-dimensional indices adds a sense of luxury, making it appealing to a wide range of ages, from younger individuals to seniors. We have carefully selected materials for each component, utilizing a Japanese movement made by CITIZEN MIYOTA and sapphire glass on both the front and back. The 38mm case size provides a perfect fit, not too large, and it offers a stylish look whether you're on or off duty. A five-link stainless steel bracelet with a luxurious look and feel. It elevates your watch with a more premium, stylish presence. Versatile and easy to pair, it matches any outfit and suits any occasion.

watches.name: GMT DIVER’S 104 black dial 200m water resistance stainless steel band
watches.description: The "GMT Divers 104" offers water resistance strong enough to withstand the pressure at the deepest part of Lake Biwa. As JIOS’s second model, the "GMT Divers 104" is designed as a traditional diver's watch, showcasing its robust 200M water resistance, capable of withstanding depths of up to 104 meters, the deepest point of Lake Biwa. It is powered by a Japanese-made "SEIKO TMI NH34A" movement and features a mechanical automatic winding system with a GMT function that allows you to track a second time zone. The case is thoughtfully designed at 40mm, making it slightly smaller than typical diver's watches, ensuring a comfortable fit for everyday use.

watches.name: GMT DIVER’S 104 Biwa Lake Kasumi dial 200m water resistance stainless steel band
watches.description: Inspired by the mist-covered surface of Lake Biwa on a winter morning, "Biwa Lake Kasumi" features a refined blue-gray dial that captures the tranquil beauty of this seasonal landscape. The watch evokes the serenity of standing quietly along the lakeshore, inviting you to enjoy elegant moments accompanied by the peaceful beauty of "Biwa Lake Kasumi." To bring a fresh contrast to the subdued blue-gray tones, the GMT hand is finished in a vibrant sky blue. The result is a versatile color combination that is equally suited to everyday wear and formal occasions. Distinctive and unlike anything commonly found from other brands, this unique colorway makes the GMT DIVER'S 104 a truly one-of-a-kind timepiece. A unique expression of Japanese scenery and craftsmanship, created for those seeking something truly different. The case is thoughtfully designed at 40mm, making it slightly smaller than typical diver's watches, ensuring a comfortable fit for everyday use.
